svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="track-flow" name="工艺流程图"> <mxGraphModel dx="1520" dy="905" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1000" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="运输轨道模块 — 工艺流程图（代码已实现）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="450" x="200" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="start" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" value="开始（自动运行）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="180" x="300" y="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="① 上游线体 SMEMA 握手来板
（本机要板 OUT / 上位机有板 IN）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="280" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="② 1段进板检测触发运输
（IN32-1，93.0-93.3）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="280" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dec" parent="1" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;" value="工作模式？" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="160" x="310" y="280" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bypass" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" value="直通模式
不停板直接过板（OneBeltByPass）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="210" x="580" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="③ PCB进入2段贴装位
停板气缸伸出定位（左/右）+ 压板气缸压紧" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="220" x="280" y="390" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="④ 通知贴片模块可贴装
（压板顶升，等待贴装完成）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="280" y="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="⑤ 贴装完成信号 → 解除压板
→ 停板气缸缩回" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="280" y="560" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="⑥ 3段出板 → 下位机要板握手" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="280" y="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p7" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="⑦ 出板完成
（支持左进右出 / 右进左出双向）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="280" y="730" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="end" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" value="循环下一板" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="160" x="310" y="820" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;dashed=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontSize=12;" value="附带功能：
· CT计时CSV
· 易损件寿命预警
· 载具计数MES上报
· 调宽模式：按配方宽度自动调宽（AutoGoTrack）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="230" x="580" y="620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f1" edge="1" parent="1" source="start" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="p1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f2" edge="1" parent="1" source="p1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="dec"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f4" edge="1" parent="1" source="dec" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;fontColor=#d6b656;" target="bypass" value="直通"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f5" edge="1" parent="1" source="dec" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;fontColor=#d79b00;" target="p3" value="贴装"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f6" edge="1" parent="1" source="p3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="p4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f7" edge="1" parent="1" source="p4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="p5"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f8" edge="1" parent="1" source="p5" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="p6"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f9" edge="1" parent="1" source="p6" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="p7"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f10" edge="1" parent="1" source="p7" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" target="end"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f11" edge="1" parent="1" source="bypass" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;strokeColor=#d6b656;" target="p7"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="685" y="755" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f12" edge="1" parent="1" source="note" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;dashed=1;endArrow=open;strokeColor=#666666;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;" target="end"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="loop" edge="1" parent="1" source="end" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;dashed=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#82b366;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" target="start"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="120" y="840" /> <mxPoint x="120" y="70" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="looptxt" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#82b366;" value="循环" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="50" x="60" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
